name: George W. Bush
summary: Bush was a conservative Republican who combined tax cuts, school accountability, faith-based initiatives and opposition to abortion and same-sex marriage with large new federal programs such as Medicare Part D and AIDS relief. In foreign policy he led the war on terror, the invasion of Iraq and a stated policy of spreading democracy, and he favored free trade and a comprehensive immigration bill with enforcement, guest workers and a conditional path to citizenship. After leaving office he warned against nativism, protectionism and isolationism.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Said government's health-care duty covers the elderly, disabled and poor children, and that for all others private insurance is the best way; proposed tax deductions and state grants instead of guaranteed coverage.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: No clear recorded position found in the sources read.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Repeatedly credited free markets and free trade with lifting lives and warned against more government control of the economy, while also backing a large federal rescue of banks in 2008.

public-ownership.rationale: No clear recorded position found in the sources read.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Signed the 2001 and 2003 tax cuts that lowered rates and phased out the estate tax, urged making them permanent and said the budget could be balanced without raising taxes.

unions-good.rationale: No clear recorded position found in the sources read.

property-fundamental.rationale: No clear recorded position found in the sources read.

regulate-corporations.rationale: No clear recorded position found in the sources read.

cut-welfare.rationale: No clear recorded position found in the sources read.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Signed the PATRIOT Act, asked Congress to reauthorize it and authorized a terrorist surveillance program on suspected al-Qaeda communications.

legalize-drugs.rationale: No clear recorded position found in the sources read.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: No clear recorded position found in the sources read.

state-harmful.rationale: Held that government has real duties, such as health care for the poor and elderly, security and the Department of Homeland Security he created.

limit-guns.rationale: No clear recorded position found in the sources read.

empower-police-military.rationale: Requested the largest defense spending increase in two decades after 9/11 and sought stronger law-enforcement tools in the PATRIOT Act.

decide-locally.rationale: No clear recorded position found in the sources read.

rehabilitation.rationale: No clear recorded position found in the sources read.

traditional-family.rationale: Called marriage a sacred institution and the foundation of society and said family character is built in families and communities.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Called for a constitutional amendment protecting marriage as the union of a man and a woman and criticized court-ordered redefinition.

abortion-legal.rationale: Asked Congress to end partial-birth abortion, signed the ban, urged a 'culture of life' and called human life a sacred gift from the Creator.

more-religion-public.rationale: Backed faith-based and community groups' access to federal funds and used religious language in public office, while saying government is not the source of values.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: No clear recorded position found in the sources read.

gender-social-construct.rationale: No clear recorded position found in the sources read.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Sought comprehensive reform with a temporary-worker program and said the border should be open to lawful immigration; opposed illegal immigration and warned against nativism.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Withdrew from the ABM Treaty and the Rome Statute, rejected Kyoto and invaded Iraq without a further UN resolution, though he also called on the UN to enforce its demands.

free-trade.rationale: Pursued free trade agreements with many countries, sought trade promotion authority and said free trade helped make America a global economic power.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Cited Saddam Hussein's abuse of his people among the reasons for the Iraq war and pointed to the liberation of women in Afghanistan.

open-borders.rationale: Called for doubling the Border Patrol, a National Guard deployment and ending catch-and-release, saying the border must be shut to illegal entry.

limit-growth.rationale: Treated economic growth as the route out of recession and to jobs, and said environmental progress should come through technology and innovation rather than limits.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Opposed the Kyoto Protocol and mandatory carbon limits, preferring technology investment and an international deal that includes every major economy; called climate change a serious challenge.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Called for 'safe, clean nuclear energy' or 'emissions-free nuclear power' in four State of the Union addresses.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Said protectionism ends in danger and decline and that conflict and poverty follow in its wake; did impose the 2002 steel tariffs, which were a departure from this stated view.

widespread-small-property.rationale: Promoted an 'ownership society' widening ownership of homes, businesses, retirement savings and health insurance.

one-party-rule.rationale: Made supporting democratic movements in every nation the stated policy of the United States, against single-party and tyrannical rule.

democracy-best.rationale: Said democracy remains the definition of political legitimacy and made ending tyranny and spreading self-government the policy of the United States.

natural-rulers.rationale: Declared that 'no one is fit to be a master, and no one deserves to be a slave' as the basis for self-government.

separate-church-state.rationale: His faith-based initiatives opened federal support to religious charities, which critics called an infringement of church-state separation.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: No clear recorded position found in the sources read.

military-superiority.rationale: Sought the largest defense increase in two decades and said whatever it costs to defend the country, America will pay.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Described America as one nation made of many peoples bound by shared ideals and criticized nationalism distorted into nativism.

hereditarian-race.rationale: No clear recorded position found in the sources read.

universal-morality.rationale: Presented liberty and human dignity as universal claims owed to all peoples, rooted in a Creator, while citing several faiths as sources of character.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Sought peace between a secure Israel and a democratic Palestine and demanded that Hamas recognize Israel.

school-vouchers.rationale: Praised DC Opportunity Scholarships that let poor children attend faith-based or other nonpublic schools and urged keeping them; did not make a general voucher demand in the texts read.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Asked for a stimulus package in 2002 while accepting a small, short-term deficit; also later pledged to balance the budget by spending restraint, so the position is mixed.

force-without-un.rationale: Led the 2003 invasion of Iraq with a coalition without a new Security Council authorization, and said America will confront threats before they fully materialize.

reason-over-faith.rationale: No clear recorded position found in the sources read.

work-for-welfare.rationale: Said good jobs must be the aim of welfare reform and that its goal is to reduce dependency and offer the dignity of work, when asking Congress to reauthorize it.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Said bigotry or white supremacy in any form is blasphemy against the American creed.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Called for more energy production at home alongside conservation, alternatives and nuclear power; also said America is addicted to oil and sought to cut imports.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Said newcomers should assimilate and embrace a common American identity including English, while presenting America as 'one nation out of many peoples' rather than demanding abandonment of heritage.

national-mission.rationale: Made 'ending tyranny in our world' US policy and said the nation's mission is advancing self-government and liberty to every nation.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Said every human being has dignity and value regardless of citizenship papers, and called white supremacy and bigotry blasphemy against the American creed.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Argued that freedom must be chosen by citizens, that no one is fit to be a master and that governments must learn to trust their people.

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: Proposed that long-resident illegal immigrants pay penalties, work for years and wait behind lawful applicants before any citizenship.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Built coalitions and alliances for the war on terror and in 2008 backed NATO membership for Ukraine and Georgia.

death-penalty.rationale: Strong supporter of capital punishment; Texas carried out 152 executions as governor and he presided over the federal execution of Timothy McVeigh.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: Described by a secondary source as supporting 'teach the controversy' on evolution; no primary text was found.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: Pointed to US food aid and the AIDS relief initiative for Africa as part of America's calling to make the world better.

collective-defense.rationale: Cited the NATO Charter's principle that an attack on one is an attack on all as the attitude of the world after 9/11, and praised NATO's role.

flat-income-tax.rationale: No clear recorded position found in the sources read.

no-bailouts.rationale: Asked Congress for a $700 billion federal rescue to buy troubled assets and keep banks lending, and said it was needed to prevent collapse.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Campaigned against quotas and said affirmative action involving quotas is unacceptable, but backed race-neutral outreach rather than abolishing all preferences.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: Set the goal of supporting democratic movements and institutions 'in every nation and culture', and rejected the idea that any people is unfit for freedom.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: Proposed that younger workers be able to divert part of their Social Security taxes into personal retirement accounts they own, while keeping the system for existing retirees; a partial rather than full replacement.

democratic-peace.rationale: Said free nations are less likely to threaten and fight each other and that free societies make America safer.

non-intervention.rationale: Intervened in Afghanistan and Iraq and made support for democratic change in every nation a policy of the United States.

defeat-communism.rationale: Praised Truman's cold-war strategy, which he said laid the foundation for victory over Soviet tyranny.

holocaust-denial.rationale: No clear recorded position found in the sources read.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: No clear recorded position found in the sources read.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Called on Egypt and other governments to open paths for peaceful opposition and condemned regimes that repress their people.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: No clear recorded position found in the sources read.

assisted-dying.rationale: Described as staunchly opposed to euthanasia; backed the Justice Department suit against Oregon's Death with Dignity Act.

islam-incompatible.rationale: Said Islam's teachings are good and peaceful, that terrorists pervert them, and honored 'the words of the Koran' among sources of American character.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Expanded the armed forces' funding and fought wars in Afghanistan and Iraq.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Championed NATO and Western alliances against rival powers, including backing NATO enlargement over Russian objections.

open-lgbt-military-service.rationale: No clear recorded position found in the sources read.

term-limits.rationale: No clear recorded position found in the sources read.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Stated that America will not wait to be attacked again and will confront threats before they fully materialize, the doctrine behind the Iraq war.

immigrants-learn-language.rationale: Said speaking and writing English is part of the common American identity and made learning English a condition for illegal immigrants seeking a path to citizenship.

voter-id.rationale: No clear recorded position found in the sources read.

women-suffrage.rationale: Celebrated women voting in Afghanistan and Iraq as part of the advance of freedom.

international-criminal-courts.rationale: Rejected US participation in the International Criminal Court and signed a law to shield US personnel from it, while favoring an Iraqi trial of Saddam Hussein.

notes: Only positions in his own speeches or his documented record are scored; unmentioned topics are null. His 2002 steel tariffs contradict his stated opposition to protectionism, and the 2006-07 immigration push was not enacted. Where speeches and record diverge, the stated recent position is used and the rationale notes the exception.
